summary: Frontend-only testing of Phase 2 'Class Hub' consolidation (institution admin admin@greenwood.edu). Verified sidebar IA, legacy route redirects, hub load + testids, class chip selection/summary, scoped vs all-classes behaviour (hideFields/extra/filter) on Sections/Enrollments/Teacher Assignments/Subject Offerings, Classes tab create with required academic unit, subject-offering duplicate rejection, delete flows, mobile layout, and regression across admin/teacher/platform pages. All test data created during the run was deleted (Greenwood restored to 1 class / 1 section / 1 enrollment / 1 teacher assignment / 0 offerings). 1 minor data bug found; no blockers.

minor.issue: academic_unit_name is only stamped on create/update, so the migrated class 'Grade 6' (unit backfilled via update_many in the migration) returns no academic_unit_name -> Classes tab 'Unit' column renders '—' even though the chip is correctly grouped under 'General'. Migration should backfill academic_unit_name, or the list should resolve the unit name (or ClassHub should fall back to units.find(id).name).

ui_bugs.issue: Existing/migrated class shows Unit '—' (see backend minor issue: academic_unit_name missing on migrated docs). Newly created classes show 'General' correctly.

integration_issues.issue: No dedupe: assigning the same teacher+class+subject with a blank section creates a second, near-duplicate assignment (existing row was Grade 6/A/Mathematics; new row Grade 6/(all)/Mathematics was accepted silently). Subject offerings do dedupe. Confirm whether class-wide vs section-level duplicates should be rejected.

action_items: Backfill academic_unit_name for classes migrated into the default unit (or resolve unit name at read time / client-side) so the Classes tab Unit column is not '—'.
Decide/implement dedupe rules for teacher_assignments (same teacher+class+subject with blank vs specific section currently both allowed).
critical_code_review_comments: InlineList: `canAdd` only validates visible required fields — correct for hidden class_name (injected via `extra`), but if `extra` is ever missing the POST would fail server-side; consider validating hidden required fields against `extra`.

ClassHub `filter`/`extra` key off `selected.name` (class name string). Renaming a class would orphan sections/offerings referencing the old name — class_name string coupling is a latent data-integrity risk (ids would be safer).
ClassHub loads 5 collections with limit 500 on every refresh; counts are computed client-side. Fine now, will not scale for large tenants — consider a server-side summary endpoint.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all Phase-2 acceptance flows pass; 1 minor display bug, 1 dedupe question)

rca_of_the_issue: academic_unit_name is denormalised into class docs inside enrich_institution_doc, which runs only on POST/PUT. The Phase-1 migration used classes.update_many to set academic_unit_id without setting academic_unit_name, so pre-existing classes lack the field and the ClassHub Classes column (key: academic_unit_name) falls back to '—'.
